tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'jug gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'jug gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog mar gtor ma gtor snod nang du me tog bdug spos sogs mchod pa btab pa gcig bsham/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ phaiṃ badz+ra a ral+li hoḥ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor spyi dang 'dra / /gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ /gang yang sa'i phyogs 'dir gtogs pa'i lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs pa sa'i bdag po rnams dang*/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kyis sa gzhi 'di dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba'i don du bdag la stsal du gsol/ de las sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba bla na med par 'gyur ba lags/ khyed cag skal ba mchog ldan te/ / bsod nams phung po gzi brjid che/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po bzod par dka'/ khyod ni bden pa'i rgyu las byung*/ khyod kyi ngag tshig bden pa yin/ /de phyir rgyu la legs bsams nas/ /bla med 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag gi bden pa'i tshig gson cig/dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du sa gzhi 'di bdag la stsol cig /a pa ra s+thā naṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha/ zhes gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro/ /de nas sa lha'i mchod gtor bsham/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā ba sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i snod bzang po rnams su/ hūṃ las byung ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs pa bzang zhing rgya che la nam mkha'i mthas klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas/ nai bi t+ye 'i bar/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūṃ/ shap+ta/ gan+dha/ ra sa/ spar sha /dharma dhā tu'i bar ro/ /yang bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ las byung ba'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ūḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ g.yas kyi sor mo gsum la gtug /sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par gyur/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa byung*/ tshom bu'i steng du 'khod par gyur pa ni/ lte ba yan chad sa'i dkyil 'khor las phyung ba/ phyag g.yon gser gyi bum pa 'dzin zhing*/ g.yas dbang por khas len pa'i phyag rgya can mdzes sdug rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /oṃ tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni/ /lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma/ /do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mchod yon 'di dag mchod nas su/ /dkyil 'khor las ni legs grub mdzod/ /oṃ pri thi bī de bi ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ mchod yon gyi gnas su me tog sogs dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar brjod/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gsol/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi stobs/ /bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ / lan gsum/ oṃ pri thi bī de bī sa pa ri ba re bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sarba duṣ+tan sa ma ya mu dra/ pra bha ñdza ka / ma ma shīn+taṃ rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyis sa gzhi la 'dug nas/ oṃ hrī swāhā/ zhes pa nas bzung*/ maṇ+ḍal mchod chog sngon du 'gro ba'i/ s+t+waṃ bha ni tā re swāhā / zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor bsgom/

bzlas pa bya/ de nas mchod pa bshams/ spyi dang mthun par byin gyis rlabs/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ bdag nyid dpal don yod grub pa rdo rje'i rta'i rgyal po rab tu khros pa sku mdog sngo sangs/ sngo dkar dmar ljang ba'i zhal spyan gsum pa/ steng zhal rta gdong sngon po'o/ /phyag g.yas pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral gri dang*/ g.yon pas sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag ma rnams kyis 'bar ba'i rdo rje mda' dang gtun shing 'dzin pa/ g.yon lhag ma rnams kyis thod pa gzhu dgra sta bsnams pa/ stag lpags dang dar dang rin po che dang rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ （《dzaṃ》+zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du lha dang lha min thams cad gnon pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa ） me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na rol pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum rdo rje sgrol mas yang dag par 'khyud pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ / sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog/ dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog/dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*/ /ye shes spyod pa rnams sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog/ dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ / rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur/ / dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab/ 'gro ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba las yongs su bsgral ba'i phyir/ bdag gis rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po sprul bar bya'o/

/oṃ badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha kro dha dṛṣ+ti āḥ kro dha dṛṣ+ti hūṃ/ rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ pad skor dang rdor dril 'dzin bzhin pas/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtugs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa maṃ/ hūṃ zhes g.yas skor du bskor nas/ lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor ba/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /lus gsum las skyes dgas par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'dir ni 'jig 'gyur gzhan du min/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe bh+yo/ sogs/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas/ sa gzhi la yungs kar gtor ro/ / oṃ bhu khaṃ nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ ghṛ h+na ghṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ ghṛh+ṇa pā ya ghṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ho bha ga bān bid+ya rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ phur bu gcig 'dus byas la/ sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo mtha' yas pa spros te/ zhes pa nas/ gdug pa'i sems can rnams thar sa med par bcings par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar bya/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gnyis pa zhig spros te/ phur bu srung ba'i don du bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lnga phul/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du phur bu srung ba dang*/ bgegs thams cad bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig/bdag nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil par gyur pa'i rkang pa hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur/ hūṃ zhes bzla zhing skor ba lan gsum byed/ gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar bgegs rnams thal bar brlag par byas/ yang hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba/ gur bla re/ ye shes kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/

zhes srung ba bya'o/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la dmigs nas/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ mtshan nges pas bstod/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsrung ba byas te bzhag go /de ltar na zhag dang po sa'i cho ga'o/ /nangs par snga bar bod lugs bzhin du sngon 'gro gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs byas na'ang nyes skyon mi bskyed cing*/ cho ga mdzes pa'i yan lag tsam du 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du skyabs sems dang yig brgya yang ngo*/ /de rjes spyi 'gro'i maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga nas brtsams te/ de yang stong pa nyid du thim par gyur/ āḥstong pa'i ngang las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ mdun gyi sa gzhir/ lha rnam gyi gnas su tshom bu dang mchod gtor bya/ dbang ldan gyi phyogs su sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu dang mchod gtor yang bshams nas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo/ / zhes pa nas/ lan bdun gyi gtor ma 'bul ba'i bar gong bzhin/ des gsungs pa/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa deng khyod kyi/ /sngags kyi cho ga rab tu grub/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor bri ba dang*/ /mtshungs pa med par 'gro don gyis/ /sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ tā re shīn+taṃ ku ru swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du thams cad kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar te/ oṃ tā re puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ/ oṃ tā re ba sha ma na ho/ oṃ tā re ni ba ra ṇa phaṭa/ oṃ ta thā ga ta tā re yaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na tā re maṃ hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma tā re paṃ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra tā re hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ aṃ ku sha ta re dzaḥhūṃ/ oṃ pā sha tā re hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ shriṅkha la tā re baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ghaṇ+ḍa tā re hoḥhūṃ/ oṃ mo ha ni tā re maṃ hūṃ/ oṃ pra sha ma tā re swāhā hūṃ/ oṃ staṃ bha ni tā re la hūṃ/

oṃ dzam bha ni tā re khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā kar+ṣa ni tā re hrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ kī la kā tā re dzaḥhūṃ/ oṃ u tsaṭ+ṭa kā tā re phaṭa hūṃ/ oṃ dwe ṣa tā re phaṭa hūṃ/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ni dhu ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya gṛ ba haṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ming sngags su grags pa rnams lan gsum gsum brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dngos grub 'byung ba'i nas/ sgo bzhir nyi ma zhes pa'i bar brjod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma chen mo dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i sde rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba phaiṃ/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsangs gtor bya/ thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa dkyil 'khor du gyur/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha na maḥ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ā sa na hūṃ/ de nas ming sngags sngags re re'i mthar/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha sogs sbyar/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa le hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ā sa na hūṃ/ so so'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma zhes pa nas/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'o/ /shar du zhi ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo nas/ zhi ba'i nyams can no/ /byang du rgyas pa'i nas/ dgyes pa'i nyams can no/ /nub tu dbang gi nas/ chags pa'i nyams can no/ /lhor drag po'i nas/ khros pa'i nyams can no/ /shar lhor de bzhin= /lho nub tu rin chen= nub byang du chos= byang shar du las kyi= /thams cad kyang nas/ mtshungs pa'o/ /shar sgor lcags kyu= lho sgor zhags pa= nub sgor lcags sgrog=

byang sgor dril bu= thams cad kyang khro mo'i nas/ brkyang pas gnas pa'o/ /shar gyi g.yas las rmongs byed ma/ zhes pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang dud kha shin tu khros/ shar lhor gshin rje gshed po nag nas/ yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs kyang 'gyed/ /lha de thams cad kyi zhes pa nas / tāṃ ljang sngon 'od zer 'phro ba'i bar ro/ /'og dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba sogs byas la/ snyan gsan dbab ste/ bdug spos thogs pas/ dam tshig sgrol ma bcom ldan 'das/ /rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snying rje'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor bri/ /de phyir byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /dgongs shig sangs rgyas sde dang tshogs/ /gang yang bstan la mngon dga' rnams/ /sems can 'di la byin rlabs shing*/ /dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ / lan gsum/ skabs 'di nyid du nam mkhar 'degs pa yin mod kyang*/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na bar 'di/ bod rnams la rjes chog tu grags pa ltar/ mchod pa gsar pa bshams pa'am kha gsos/ byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas/ oṃ bha ga bān ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri ba re/ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis mchod/ yi ge bcu pa la sogs pa lha so so'i mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul/ mtshan nges pas bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ gtso bos nus pa sogs/ gang yang bdag blo sogs/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hoḥ dkyil 'khor gyi lha nam mkhar bteg ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyi sogs kyis bstod/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis srung ba bya/ de nas bum pa sta gon ni/ skabs 'di nyid du bum pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas pa tsam bum pa'i sta gon yin no/ /slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba ni/ mya ngan 'das pa'i sems bskyed dang*/

nang dbang dang*/ gsol btab dang*/ spro ba bskyed pa dang*/ sdom pa sbyin par gsol ba dang*/ sdom pa bsgrags pa rgyas pa dang*/ bzung ba bsdus pa dang*/ so shing dang*/ khyor chu dang*/ srung skud dang*/ ku sha sbyin pa dang*/ srung ba dang*/ mthong bar 'gyur bar sgrog pa rnams yin te/ dkyil chog tu bshad zin to/ /de dag ni nub gnyis sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /thig tshon byin rlabs kyang spyi dang 'dra mod/ ngag 'don tsam brjod na/ thig tshon bkod/ mchog gtor bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las shar du thig skud dang rdul tshon sngon po hūṃ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma sngon mo/ rang dang 'dra ba dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ lhor ser po trāṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki ser mo rang dang mtshungs pa dang*/ sogs nub tu= dmar po hrīḥlas 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas pad+ma dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo rang dang sogs/ byang du= thig skud dang rdul tshon oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po/ 'khor lo dang*/ des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ rang dang mtshungs pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

de bzhin du sbyar te/ dbus su ljang khu a las don yod grub pa sogs/ sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas ral gri dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum sgrol ma ljang khu sogs/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yab rnams thor tshugs dang ldan zhing rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ yum rnams zhig phyis （《dzaṃ》+ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ） dang*/ pad+ma'i skyil krung*/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po nas/ hūṃ sngon po/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar po nas/ kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo'o/ /rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' rgyal ba rigs lnga dang*/ yum lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rdo rje rol pa mo'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ri bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes dbang bskur/ nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ pañtsa ku la dhi pa sa pa ri bā re bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī a/ a kā ro sogs lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ yang ar+ghaṃ sogs bsdus pas mchod/ mkha' ltar kun tu khyab pa yi/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje/ /yon tan 'phrin las mnyam pa nyid/ / bde gshegs yab yum rnams la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ kun 'grub shog /rigs lnga yab yum bcu byang chub kyi sems su zhu nas/ thig skud kha dog lnga rnams dang*/ rdul tshon kha dog lnga rnams su gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka trāṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a ra l̥ka hrīḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā dhṛka ā hūṃ/ zhes mang du bzlas / dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes thig skud brkyangs/ oṃ a no n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharma pa raspa ra/

a nu pra bṛṣ+ta sarba dharma ār+yan ta/ a nu pra pṛṣ+ta sarba dharma hūṃ/ zhes sgril/ oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas/ /deng 'dir byin gyis rlobs shig ces/ /thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs/ /hūṃ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra su tra sa ma ya/ mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ de nas las thig gdab ste/ gzhan ni spyi dang 'dra/ rta babs sgo tshad gcig tu bya/ /snam bu bzhi par byed na ni/ /snam bu 'og ma ka rgyan mnyam/ /gnyis pa cha chung re res ring*/ /gsum pa mun pa'i snam bu mnyam/ /bzhi pa de las gcig gis bskum/ /gsum pa'i dbus su tshangs thig gi /g.yas g.yon cha chung re re dang*/ /gnyis pa la ni gsum gsum dang*/ /dang po la ni gnyis gnyis te/ /yang na glang rgyab mig gsum bya/ /snam bu bcu gcig spyi dang mtshungs/ /de yi nang tshan gsum po yang*/ /ji ltar 'dod pa sbyar du rung*/ /ka ba ka rgyan mun pa dag/rtsig pa'i thig la reg par gdab/ /rta babs kyi ni g.yas g.yon du/ /mchod rten gnyis ni bya bar 'dod/ /cha chung gnyis ni stegs bu ste/ /de nas gnyis ni dril bu'o/ /bzhi pa bum pa'i gnas su 'dod/ /rtsig pa'i nang gi khyad par ni/ /bzhi pa dang ni gsum pa gnyis/ /phyed gdab nang ma'ang phyed du gdab/ /de dbus re mig dgu pa ste/ /de nas sgo yi rtsa thig phyis/ /rdul tshon blangs te/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ zhes mang du bzlas te/ phur khung dgang*/ 'di ni chos nyid dag pa ste/ / sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya/ /oṃ sa ma ya ho ā haṃ/ zhes dbang ldan nas brtsams te bri bar bya'o/ /dbus kyi gdung dang ka ba nag/re mig rnams dang gru chad sngo/ /ut+pal dmar po sil mar bkram/ /phyi nas rim bzhin snam bu lnga/ /nag dmar sna tshogs ser dang dkar/ /lha rnams phyogs mdog rtsig pa ni/

/nang nas ljang dmar ser nag dkar/ /dra phyed phyi bstan mun pa nag/mchod rten dkar zhing khyam ljang khu/ /ka rgyan glang po seṅge sogs/ /dbus su ut+pal sngon po bri/ /phyogs bzhir pad dkar gser bum dang*/ /lcags kyu ral gri phyogs mdog bri/ /mtshams bzhir ut+pal sku mdog mtshungs/ /grwa bzhir tho ba ral gri dang*/ /dbyug pa phur bu rnam par dgod/ /las kyi snam bu dbus ma la/ /lha yi mdog mtshungs gdan du bya/ /phyag mtshan bri na g.yas kyi'o/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa dang*/ /lcags sgrog dril bu mdzes par bri/ /bum pa sgrub pa ni/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa'am/ ma 'byor na bum pa lnga/ stegs bu'i steng du lnga tshoms su bkod/ las bum logs zhig tu bya ste/ bum pa drug go /'dir drug gi dbang du byas nas/ bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa ser po yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyis dkris pa'o/ /oṃ tap+te tap+te mahā tap+te swāhā/ lha'i chu bo rab tu 'bab par gyur/ oṃ kalpa pṛ k+ṣā ya swāhā/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan par gyur/ dbus kyi bum pa'i gnas su pad+ma zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ tāṃ las bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo dam tshig sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma zhes pa nas/ 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa'o/ /shar du tāṃ laṃ las sogs/ lhor tāṃ maṃ las sogs/ nub tu tāṃ paṃ las sogs/ byang du tāṃ hūṃ las sogs/ gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ / shar du dzaḥlas sogs/ lhor hūṃ las sogs/ nub tu baṃ las sogs/ byang du hoḥlas nas/ g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /mtshams rnams su hūṃ re re yongs su gyur pa las/ shar lhor gshin rje gshed po nag ces pa nas/ yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs kyang 'gyed/ / ces pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin/ shar gyi bum pa'i nang du/ swāhā las zhi ba'i

nas/ zhi ba'i nyams can rmongs byed ma dang dug zhi bar byed ma spro ba/ byang gi bum par oṃ las nas/ dgyes pa'i nyams can/ rengs byed ma dang gnon par byed ma spro ba'o/ /nub kyi bum par hoḥlas nas/ chags pa'i nyams can/ 'gugs par byed ma dang phur bus 'debs par byed ma spro ba'o/ /lho'i bum par phaṭa las nas/ drag po'i sgrol ma/ khros pa'i nyams can/ bskyod byed ma dang*/ dbye byed ma spro ba'o/ /las bum du hūṃ las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nag ces pa nas/ 'dod lha zhabs kyis mnan/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ nas/ gnas kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ ā haṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ gtso mo la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan pa dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso mos dbu rgyan/ yi ge bcu pa ci 'grub dang*/ rtsa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ las bum la dmigs nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyang brgya rtsa sogs bzla'o/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ nyer gcig tsam bzla/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥtāṃ hūṃ/ swahā oṃ ho phaṭa/ taṃ lāṃ tāṃ māṃ tāṃ pāṃ tāṃ hūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes nang mchod phul/ a nu rā ga'i sngags kyis rjes chags bya/ mtshan nges pas bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ me tog dkar po dang bcas pa'i mchod yon phul/ lha rnams bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du 'dres par gyur/ las bum gyi chu blangs te bum pa la bskor/ gnas khang la gtor/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas/ bar chad srungs shig ces brjod/ de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bris zin pa la/ byur bsal ba dang*/ bsrung ba byas/

rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bum pa rnams dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing*/ bum pa lnga po 'jog stabs bde na/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su stegs bu'i steng du bzhagalas bum dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad dam/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag go /de dag ni nyi ma gsum pa'i bya ba'o/ /nangs par snga bar yo byad rnams tshogs par byas te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas rnams sngon du btang*/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zhes pa nas/ srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de'i nang du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po/ zhes pa nas/ sgo bzhir sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan/ de nas bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can rdzogs par bkod yod na skad cig gis lha rnams bskyed dgos shing*/ ras bris la yang de bzhin no/ /sa bon la yi ge nyid dang*/ thig le las sa bon phyag mtshan gang rung bskyed dgos/ 'on kyang skabs 'dir phyag mtshan 'god pa nyid gtso che bas/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rab tu rgyas pa'i ut+pal sngon po/ sdong bu dang bcas pa 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /re mig brgyad la/ shar du pad+ma dkar po/ byang du gser gyi bum pa rab tu gang ba/ nub tu lcags kyu/ lho ru ral gri/ shar lhor ut+pal dkar po/ lho nub tu ut+pal ser po/ nub byang du ut+pal dmar po/ byang du ut+pal nag po/ shar sgor lcags kyu/ lho sgor zhags pa/ nub sgor lcags sgrog/byang sgor dril bu/ shar lho'i grwar tho ba/ lho nub kyi grwar ral gri/ nub byang gi grwar dbyug pa dkar po/ byang shar gyi grwar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i phur bu/ las kyi snam bu la/ shar du rtse gsum dang*/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ byang du lcags sgrog dang ri rab/ nub tu lcags kyu dang phur bu/ lhor dbyug tho dang ral gri rnams grub par gyur/

oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hūṃ phaṭa nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ kyi bar gong lhag gnas kyi skabs bzhin/ lan gsum gsum brjod/ yi ge brgya pa yang gtso mo la bdun sogs dang*/ lha gzhan rnams la re re bzla'o/ /de nas bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug par bsams la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga thun mong ba de mi dgos/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol mar gsal ba'i zhes pa nas/ ye shes tshogs bsag gi skabs snying ga'i 'od kyis snang ba thams cad dang*/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor yang 'od du zhu nas bdag nyid la thim/ bdag nyid kyang thugs ka'i tāṃ la zhes pa nas/ stu tī badz+ra swa bha ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin no/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad cing bsangs gtor bya/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ dpa' bo rdo rje'i brtul zhugs can/ /rdo rje sems dpas byin rlabs de bzhin gshegs lnga yis/ /dbu la brgyan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam 'jig rten gsum po skyob mdzad ma/ /phyogs bcu bdud kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus bcom zhing 'joms mdzad rab bzhad bcom ldan 'das mar 'dud/ / ces bstod/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ nas/ ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ bar 'dir 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma'i bzlas pa yang ci rigs par bya'o/ /mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i mchod pa'i khang pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod sna tshogs pa dag tu/ hūṃ las skyes pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog/bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ gzugs sgra/ dri ro/ reg bya la sogs pa/ phyi nang gsang ba/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha'i mthas klas pa 'khor ba ji srid du 'byung bar gyur/

oṃ badz+ra añtsa ma naṃ swā hā/ pād+yaṃ= pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ= oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai bi te/ rū pa badz+ra/ shap+ta/ gan+dha/ rā sa/ spar+sha/ dharma dhā tu badz+ra= badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs/ khyab rtag bde chen ye shes rol pa las/ /yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje ar+gha'i rgyun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshor rab spel bas/ /ye shes lha mo'i dkyil 'khor mnyes gyur cig/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bha ga ba tī sa ma ya tā ra yo gi nī maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri bā ra pra ba ra sat+ka rā r+thaṃ añtsa ma ni pra tits+tsha na maḥ de bzhin du sbyar te/ rkang pa gnyis pa/ zhabs kyi pad+ma'i dri bcil rdo rje'i chu/ /pād+yaṃ/ zhal gyi rnyog sel rdo rje spos kyi chu/ /añtsa ma nāṃ/ kun tu 'pho ba'i gdung sel 'thor 'thung mchog/pro k+ṣa ṇaṃ/ oṃ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi /rdo rje nyi ma pad+mar phyung*/ /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid mchog/sa pa ri ba ra badz+ra puṣ+pe/ rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min cing*/ /lte bar gtum mo'i me yis ni/ /nges par bsregs pa de yi spos/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /badz+ra dhū pe/ yi ge hūṃ las yang dag byung*/ /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od/ / thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /badz+ra ā lo ke /bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*/ /de nyid kyis kyang byug pa ni/ / thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /badz+ra gan+dhe/ 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ / dbang po thams cad yang dag brten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya/ /badz+re nai bi te/ chu skyes rdo rje yang dag sbyor/ / zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung*/ /rnal 'byor pa yi mi shigs sgra/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /badz+ra shap+ta/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rigs bdag dbyer med pa la 'bul te/

phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du mchod pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bar 'dir bod lugs ltar na brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan smos nas kyang 'bul/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar 'bru gsum / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ 'bru gsum sbyar bas phul/ bar 'dir chos skyong srung ma dang*/ 'gro ba drug la sbyin pa sogs kyang bod lugs zhig dang bstun pas khyab/ de rjes rig ma bcu drug gis mchod pa/ spros pa la mngon par dga' na/ mthon mthing lang tshos dregs pa'i yid 'phrog ma/ / zhes sogs sngon byung blo gros gsal ba rnams kyis sbyar ba/ tshig don legs po dag brjod cing*/ bsdu na sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod pa'o/ /de nas na bza' 'bul te/ bsangs sbyangs/

hū?ṃ las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi yo byad nam bza'i tshogs dpag tu med par gyur/ dbang po'i gzhu 'dra rta mchog rigs la ste/ / rtag pa'i rigs la kañtsa li ka sbyar/ /stag lpags g.yang gzhi la sogs rdo rje'i rigs/ /yid 'ong reg 'jam 'jig rten dbang phyug la/ /rdo rje nyi mar bye ba'i rin thang can/ /dar dkar tshi gu'i na bza' bde chen rigs/ /rdo rje reg bde'i bde ba gos zung rnams/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /badz+ra bas+t+ra/ gzhan yang rin chen bdun dang*/ 'dod yon lnga sogs spyi dang mthun pa'i spros pa sna tshogs kyang bkag pa ma yin no/ /de rjes mtshan nges pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bstod pa nges par bya la/ bstod pa gzhan gyis kyang bstod par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul te/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las nas/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥswāhā 'i bar gyis byin gyis brlabs/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya nas/ staṃ bha ni tā re i daṃ ba liṃ ghṛh+ṇa ghṛg+ṇa sarba duṣ+ta na sa ma ya mu dra/ pra bhañdza ka /mam ma shān+ting rak+ṣa tsa ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun dang*/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ/ zhes pa nas/ bi sañtsa re swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar du dkyil 'khor pa spyi la 'bul/ dur khrod gnas pa rnams la/ oṃ phaiṃ sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis bsngo/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sgyu 'phrul chen mo dpal ldan ma/ /dbyangs can ma dang dka' bzlog khyod/ /zla ba nyi ma chu lha dang*/ /gu lang 'phrog byed rnams kyis btud/ khyod ni srid gsum byed pa mo/ /sems can kun la bde sbyin ma/ /bskyed dang 'jig dang bsrung ba mo/ /lha mo sgrol ma 'khor bcas bstod/ /lha'i tshogs rnams zhes pa nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ gi bar bya/ bsdu na nang gtor de tsam gyis chog la/ cung zad spros pa la mos na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bzhin phyi rol gtor ma gtong*/

mchog tu spros pa la mos na/ snying po mdor bsags sogs las 'byung ba'i phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma byed do/ /de rjes shar sgo nas/ kol+la i ri riṭha la sogs pa rdo rje'i glu blangs/ oṃ badz+ra ud ghā ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūṃ/ lan bzhis sgo phye/ oṃ rdo rje sems khyod rol zhing rol bar mdzad/ /thams cad mthu yis thams cad stsol bar mdzad/ /ji snyed mchod pa de snyed bdag 'bul na/ /'khor bar gnas pa skad cig gis grol mdzod/ /sa ma ya ho ho ཿ zhes gsol ba btab/ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ / sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrab tu grub par mdzod/ mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes shig ho/ /zhes me tog phul/ sa ma ya pra be sha ya ho/ / zhes dkyil 'khor du 'jug go /bar 'dir mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ci nus bya/ de nas bar 'dir gsang ba'i mchod pa yid kyis 'bul ba yin te/ tshig gis brjod pa ni ma bris so/ /de rjes rang gi snying ga nas 'phags ma sgrol ma phyag gnyis ma zhes pa nas/ thar pa med par bcings par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis/ / sogs kyis bstod do/ /smon lam dang*/ shis brjod bsdus pa zhig bya'o/ /de nas bdag 'jug ni maṇ+ḍal phul/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po las/ /'don par mdzad pa khyod 'ba' zhig/dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ bar 'dir chas 'jug gsum byed kyang*/ bdag 'jug gi skabs mi dgos/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhe sogs bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring gis mig dar bcings/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum skye ba'i gnas lngar tāṃ yig re res rgyas gdab/ oṃ ro ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ni/

sarba ar+tha sā dha ya swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra mā ma kī/ ki ri ki ri hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ ka ṭe bi ka ṭe bi ka ṭa/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dha tī shwa ri/ sarba duṣ+taṃ ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bi dh+wan sa ya bi dh+wan sa ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra twa re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ na maḥs man+ta sogs bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sogs sngags lan bdun （《dzaṃ》+ brjod de/ ） gnas bdun du rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bzhag / kye khyod su yin/ bdag ni skal ba bzang po'o/ /skal bzang des khyod su zhig bya/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig bdag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi snying gar snying rje chen po'i ngo bo zla ba'i steng du stong nyid ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga pa'o/ /oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pā da ya mi/ mahā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta u pa da ya mi a khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad mo yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hūṃ na maḥste hūṃ/ na maḥmā+e hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ swāhā/ phyogs re re nas lan gsum gsum/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ 'phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar dam bzhag lnga'am/ yang na/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ / gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /'di ni khyed kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra uta ta ka ṭha ṭha hūṃ/ deng nas brtsams te nga yi bka'/

khyod kyi brnyas par mi bya zhing*/ /dam tshig dang 'gal mi bya ste/ dang por dmyal bar 'gro 'gyur ro/ / zhes so/ / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig/dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ rang skad cig gis 'od dpag med he ru kar gyur/ rkang 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ steng du rkang mthil gyi nang du chug pa'i dzhaiḥyig ljang khus mtshan pa/ snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbus su nyi ma la hūṃ nag po thugs rdo rje/ mgrin par raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ dbus su nyi ma la āḥdamar po gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ mgo bor baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas mtshan pa/ dbus su zla ba la ha dkar po sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad/ thugs dang*/ gsung dang*/ sku rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ hūṃ āḥhāḥrnams la thim/ rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos/ dzhaiḥl bskul/ de'i 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang gang zhing*/ lus gyen du 'degs bzhin pa la/ yi ge gsum bskul bas de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis lus kyi nang mtha' dag gang bar gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs te thim/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya/ sa staṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya tsā la ya/ hūṃ āḥhāḥdzhaiḥ zhes ye shes phab/ spogs chog gnyis dang gegs sel bdag 'jug gi skabs su mi dgos/ oṃ teṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya/ pra ti （《dzaṃ》+ pra ti ） pa ti ta/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brtan par byas/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs kyang lugs 'di la nam mkha'i kha dog dri ba mi mdzad/ bden stobs brjod pa mdzad mod/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su ma byas kyang chog

/oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi ḍho me bha ba/ sha shwa twa me bha ba/ hri da ya me/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi m+me/ pra yats+tsha （《dzaṃ》+ hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ ） ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ pra tits+tsha ku su ma añdza li/ na tha hoḥ me tog phul/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ/ e maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang*/ khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla med pa/ /thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūṃ a/ he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyi/ /rdo rje pad+ma mchog rol bas/ /gsang sngags rnams la sgrub par gyis/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal pra be sho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal dṛ shi to3haṃ/ oṃ gu h+ya maṇ+ḍal mahā maṇ+ḍal a bhi ṣik+to3haṃ/ dngos gzhi las slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas kun dang slob dpon dbyer ma mchis pa/ dpal don yod grub pa rdo rje rta'i rgyal po/ zhes pa nas/ 'khyud pa'i skur gyur/ ye shes sems dpa'i skabs bzhin/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa zhal du bcug/rjes chags kyi mes thugs kar zhu/ gzhi gnas kyi byang chub sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi pad+mar babs pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo'i skur gyur/ dpral bar oṃ nas/ kun tu bzang po'i ngo bo/ /gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma dam tshig sgrol ma'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza

nas/ hoḥ 'i bar/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ / 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub kyi sems su bzhu/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi rnam snang gi sgo spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu nas/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing*/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa bkrus/ dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rdul phra rab rnams yum gyi pad+ma nas phyir spros te/ dbang gi lha tshogs su gyur nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ hūṃ zhes bya bas yum gyi pad+ma'i g.yon gyi mtha' nas phyir spros te/ shar sgo dang nye ba'i lha snam la dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ / sogs dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs brjod/ rang gi rigs kyi lhas me tog 'phreng ba spyi bor bcings par gyur/ oṃ prati gṛ h+ṇa s+t+waṃ sogs lha thams cad kyi bum chu dung chos su bsdus pa'am/ rig pa'i bum pa logs su bcas yod na des dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shri ye hūṃ/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba'am/ dar ras kyi cod pan bcings/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ri bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ snying po yi ge bcu pa lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid kyi rgyud la/

bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu ma lus pa thogs med du 'jug par gyur cig / de dag ni rig pa brtad pa'i dbang zhes bya ste dbang po dman pa rnams rjes su 'dzin par byed do/ /thod par gnas pa'i bum chu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ māṃ mā ma kī dang*/ lāṃ sangs rgyas spyan ma dang*/ pāṃ gos dkar mo dang*/ tāṃ dam tshig sgrol ma rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i bum chu nus pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid mi bskyod pa he ru ka mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sku mdog sngon po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rus pa'i rgyan dang thod pa'i 'phreng ba can/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ nas/ ghan+ḍe ho/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ dbang gi lha rnams kyi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum las byung*/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i/ /gnas kyi dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ laṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ hūṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ de ltar na chus dbang bskur bas/ sems rnam par shes pa kun gzhi gnas gyur te/ ji lta ba gzigs pa'i ye shes thugs rdo rje mngon du byas so/ / bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo bh+ruṃ yig dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bo aṃ yig dang*/ 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo dz+riṃ yig dang*/ don yod grub pa'i ngo bo khaṃ yig dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo hūṃ yig las byung ba'i rin po che'i cod pan de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i sku gzugs kyis mtshan par gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan he ru ka rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan can sku mdog ser po/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum mā ma kī dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rus pa'i rgyan dang*/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba can/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ nas/ ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ yi bar bya/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsan+tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga tā lan gsum/ dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ hū?ṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ de ltar na cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs la sogs pa 'khor ba' ི chos rnams kyi yon tan rnams gnas gyur te 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid yon tan rdo rje mngon du byas so/ /

bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag don yod grub pa'i ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid 'od dpag med he ru ka （《dzaṃ》+'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can ） sku mdog dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu= yum gos dkar mo= bcas pa thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rnam par= ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ'i bar/ gong bzhin la 'don pa spo/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis rdo rjes dbang bskur/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang gis ni/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ / sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir/ /rdo rje 'di ni blang bar gyis/ /oṃ hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā sogs/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ / rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /de ltar na rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas/ ngag ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs gnas gyur te/ brjod bral sgra dbyangs thams cad pa gsung rdo rje mngon du byas/ bsangs sbyangs dril bu stong pa'i ngang las/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor lo dbang phyug ma dam tshig gi sgrol ma'i ngo bo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid don yod grub pa he ru ka don yod grub pa'i= sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu= yum las kyi sgrol ma dang = thams cad don yod grub pa'i rnam par= ces 'don pa spo/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dril bus dbang bskur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ / oṃ hūṃ tāṃ hūṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ sarba nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/

/rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra dharma āḥ de ltar na dril bu'i dbang bskur bas/ las dang bya ba thams cad gnas gyur te/ lhun grub thogs pa med pa'i 'phrin las rdo rje mngon du byas/ yang rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ rdo rje lcags kyu ma'i ngo bos dzaḥyig dang*/ rdo rje zhags pa ma'i ngo bo hūṃ yig dang*/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i ngo bo baṃ yig dang*/ rdo rje dril bu ma'i ngo bo hoḥyig rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje dril bur gyur/ bdag nyid stong pa'i ngang las rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka /rnam par snang mdzad kyi= sku mdog dkar po/ 'khor lo dang dril bu/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma= rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam par= dbang gi lha rnams kyis ming gi dbang bskur/ oṃ dza:hūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra sa twa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣits+tsha hūṃ/ badz+ra nā maḥ.a bhi ṣe ka ta ha shrī/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā= da ེ ltar na ming gi dbang bskur bas/ ming gi gdags gzhi yul dang dbang po thams cad gnas gyur te/ ji snyed mkhyen cing snang stong gnyis su med cing mi shig pa/ sku rdo rje'i go 'phang mngon du byas so/ / de dag ni slob ma'i dbang dngos gzhi yin la mtha' rten ni/ （《dzaṃ》+ oṃ badz+ra ne tra a wa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ ） thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ / rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /āḥ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i me long bzhin/ /'dir ni gsal bdag rnyog pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/

/ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ / sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ （《dzaṃ》+ dril bu blangs la/ a a a/ ） thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ / nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur pa/ / thams cad mchog gi mnyam nyid gsal/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya mi/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya swa/ oṃ shu n+ya tā= stong pa'i ngang las swāhā las rang nyid zhi ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo= sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re shān+tiṃ ku ru/ badz+rī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ rang nyid rgyus pa'i sgrol ma ser mor gyur/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs/ dha na puṣ+tiṃ ku ru/ rang nyid dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mor gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs/ sarba sa dh+ya pa shaṃ ku ru/ rang nyid drag po'i las kyi sgrol ma nag mor gyur= sarba duṣ+ta na pra duṣ+ta na ma raṃ ku ru/ zhes 'don pa spo/ las bzhi'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /bsangs sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rdo rje/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje sems dpa'i= rdo rje dang dril bu/ yum rdo rje snyems mas/ badz+ra ghan+ṭe ho yi bar chu dbang gi skabs ltar ro/ /rdo rje lag tu gtad/ rang gi snying gar yang rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpar gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /rdo rje'i sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ/ dha ra ya mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ lag pa g.yas su hūṃ las byung ba'i gri gug/oṃ karti ka /sarba mā ra ṇaṃ/ maṃ sa kartā ya/ kartā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lag pa g.yon du āḥlas byung ba'i thod khrag/oṃ badz+ra ka pā la sarba shā truṃ ṇaṃ/

rak+taṃ dhā ra ya dhā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ lag pa g.yas su oṃ las byung ba'i cang te'u/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ g.yon du ut+pal/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya sogs rtsa sngags so/ / yang g.yon du tāṃ las byung ba'i mdung rtse gsum pa/ oṃ ha na ha na mā ra （《dzaṃ》+ ya mā ra ya ） sarba shā trun tri shu la hūṃ phaṭa/ haṃ las byung ba'i kha ṭ+waṃ ga mchan khung du bkod/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la bh+yoḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes sgoms shig/'di ltar ngas khyod lung bstan te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin bshegs/ /srid pa shin tu dag pas na/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /he badz+ra aṅku ri/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra shi ṣ+ya sa ma ya/ bhur+bhu ba swa/ gang ngas lung bstan pa 'di la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ / de nas dbang de tsam las mi bskur na/ skabs 'dir dam tshig bshad do/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ /dam pa bdag la stsal nas kyang*/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ / sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ /oṃ mahā badz+ra hūṃ/ thog mtha' med pa'i sogs/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun sogs/ āḥsrid pa sogs/ yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir sogs/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs kar gzhal med khang lha'i gdan dang bcas pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ tā re sogs yi ge bcu pa dang*/

lha rnams kyi mtshan sngags rdzogs par brjod/ gtso mo'i thugs ka'i lha tshogs rnams phyir spros te/ rang gi snying ga'i gzhal yas khang gi nang*/ lha'i gdan rnams su 'khod par gyur/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog/rgyas par na zhal phyag rnams gsal gdab bo/ / dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes sems dpa' lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i tshogs rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ āḥlas byung ba'i bgrang 'phreng gsung rdo rje 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ a ā i ī nas/ ha k+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ snying po lan mang du bzlas/ 'phreng ba spyi bor bzhag snying ga'i lha tshogs rnams sa bon gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ga nas/ ye shes sems dpa' sngags kyi yig 'bru'i gzugs can badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'o/ / de snying gar bstad/ snying po'i mthar/ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sogs/ rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi sngags btags te/ hi hūṃ yig 'bru'i dkyil 'khor rnams phyag mtshan gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor las/ ye shes sems dpa' phyag mtshan gyi rnam par badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mtshon cha 'khor lo bla na med/ /rnal 'byor ma yi bu khyod long*/ /'khor lo'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra brta ni a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ de bzhin du/ rdo rje dang*/ badz+ra/ rin chen dang rat+na/ chu skyes dang pad+ma/ ral gri dang khaṭ+ga/ zhes pa ni thugs kyi dbang ngo*/ /oṃ dha ra dha ra dhā ra ya dhā ra ya/ mar+dha mar+dha/ badz+ra dhṛ ka phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dharma sa ma ya swa s+t+waṃ/ hu lu hu lu/ a ro lika phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sūr+ya/ ta mo bi da ma na swāhā/ a hāṃ/ rat+na dh+rika phaṭa/ oṃ sha shwa to pa ra ma sha shwa to/ e h+ya hi/ dzi na dzi ka bh+ruṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phu phu phu hi hi hi pra dz+nyā dhṛka hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ āḥhūṃ haṃ/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi 'phreng ba rin chen bdag/lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ske rags la ni don yod gnas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni shes rab ste/ /thabs kyi rang bzhin cang te nyid/ /rnal 'byor ma yi ming bos bzung*/ / sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu bzung la/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug/sdang bar bya dang gnon sogs dang*/ /bsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis/ / 'di la slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ las bzhi'i bum pas dbang bskur ro/ /grub pa brgyad kyi gzugs brnyan bstar te / ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*/ / mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar bsgrub par bgyi/ /rig ma dam tshig sgrol ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa la/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya chen por gnas pas/ nu ma la reg cing 'khyud pa na/ dga' ba dang po mi 'gyur zhing brtan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a nu rā ga na āḥhūṃ/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ / sogs kyi mjug tu/ oṃ badz+ra ut+ta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ swa ra ta s+t+waṃ/ ā haṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang*/ ye dharma brjod/ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ / sogs kyis me tog gtor/ rol chen bya/ slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /de bzhin khros pas spun rnams la/ /nyes pa brjod par mi bya'o/ /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang spang bar mi bya'o/ / byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ / （《dzaṃ》+ rang gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ ） / yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba nyid ni bstan mi bya/ /bdag nyid phung po smad mi bya/ /chos la yid gnyis mi bya zhing*/ /gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/ /chos nyid tshad ni gzung mi bya/ /skal ldan sems can bslu mi bya/

/rtag tu dam tshig bsten par bya/ /shes rab rang bzhin bud med la/ /skyon gyi nyes pa mi brjod do/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ / lan gsum/ gsang ba 'di su la'ang smra bar mi bya'o/ /gal te smras na de yi tshe/ /shin tu rno ba'i shu la ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi phyag na gnas/ /gang gi dam tshig 'jig byed pa/ /de la 'di yis mchog tu 'big/oṃ ma hā sa ma ya hā na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ spro na/ de ring khyod ni dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin pa/ / sogs dang*/ mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'dir/ / zhes pa nas/ khyed rnams brtan par 'gyur gyi bar dbugs dbyung ring mo 'phreng ba nas 'byung gi bar brjod de bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ / （《dzaṃ》+de ltar na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dag/sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin no/） /gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya yang mdun du bstar/ khyed la 'di ni 'bul lags kyi/ /'dod don bde ba rab tu stsol/ /bdag ni 'dod pa'i bde don gnyer/ /mgon po khyod kyis brtse bas gzung*/ /byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags thung gis mig dar bcing*/ mgrin par chos 'byung gi dbus su sngags 'phreng g.yon du 'khor bar gyur/ ā li kā li brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/ oṃ badz+ra ut+ta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ oṃ laṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ bh+ruṃ āṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ khaṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ oṃ hūṃ tāṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ āḥsrid pa sogs/ yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/

/ sogs/ oṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra satwa s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ rjes chags kyi mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba/ thabs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba don yod grub pa'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ thugs kar gzhi gnas kyi byang chub sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres te/ rtsa a ba dhu tī'i lam nas brgyud/ rdo rje nor bur lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas/ byang chub kyi sems mthe bong dang ming med kyi blangs te lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /de bzhin du ni byang chub sems/ /bzang pos bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ 'di ste dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga las byung bcud kyi len/ /bde ba chen po myang bar gyis/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ e ma ho bde ba chen po'o/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūṃ ā/

gdong g.yogs bsal/ pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor la bltas pas mchog tu dga' ba 'gyur ba med pa brtan par byas/ slar yang bdud rtsi myang*/ khrag chen po ni ga bur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar dang yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i chu dang bcas/ /lnga pa sems las byung bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mthun par gsungs/ /bzang po khyod kyis bskyang bar bya/ /de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i/ ngag gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag/gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i go 'phang thob par gyur/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ / sogs lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba gang*/ /rang bzhin med pa'i bdag nyid de/ / ye shes mtshon cha rnams 'chang ba/ /mngon spyod sna tshogs spyod pa po/ /ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i sngags can ma/ /dbang po'i dra ba 'phro zhing 'od zer 'khrug/lhan cig skyes pa'i mdzes ma dang gcugs mdzad/ /blo gros chen pos bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ / lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pa'i/ /lha mo 'di ni khyod la shis/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/ / rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya lo/ /gzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /bdag nyid rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag don yod grub pa dang*/ rig ma dam tshig sgrol ma'i skur gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi myang*/ oṃ badz+ra uta ta ka nas gzung*/ dam tshig gsum gyi bar gong gsang dbang gi skabs bzhin/ spyi bor oṃ nas kun tu bzang po'i bar/ sku gsung thugs dang skye mched byin gyis brlabs/ dang po dga' ba dpa' bo ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnal 'byor ma/

/shin tu bde dga' thams cad nges/ /de bde thabs las yang dag rig/shes rab sbyor pas dpal ldan ni/ /'di nyid yang dag mtshon par bya/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag gi sems/ /nor bu'i nang du son lta bas/ /ci ste bu khyod 'di spro'am/ /nga las dam tshig len par ni/ /bshang gci rak+ta bza' ba dang*/ /bha ga'i mtha' nas 'jib byed dam/ khyod las dam tshig bza' bar ni/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gi mi mo kun gus bya/ /chu skyes rab tu rgyas pa gsal bar byas te/ a re bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bstan byed pa/ /bdag la dngos grub stsol mdzad ma/ /dal bu dal bur rab sbyor bas/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ / dbus su ze 'brus rnam brgyan pa'i/ /chu skyes 'dab ma gsum par gzigs/ / a ho bde ba can gyi zhing*/ /sangs rgyas sku mdog dmar pos mdzes/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lor tshol/ /des ni bu khyod 'bras bur bcas/ /hrīḥlas pad+ma/ āḥlas ze 'bru/ hūṃ las rdo rje/ oṃ las nor bu/ bu gar phaṭa kyis bkag pa dang bcas pa'o/ /rol zhig rol zhig bdag la rol/ /'dod pa gyis shig dga' gsal ba/ khyod kyis gzhan du mi rtog pa/ /rtogs pas the tshom ma byed cig/ ces bskul nas/ rjes chags spel ba dang*/ kha ga mu kha btsal ba dang*/ rgyu bsnyen sgrub bzhi las 'bras bu ye shes 'char ba dang*/ skad cig ma bzhi las mtshan nyid bral ba la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa mngon du gyur pa dang*/ de las snying stobs brgyad dang*/ rjes chags kyi sa bcu thob par gyur te/ thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro ba gsum 'di dag pa yin/ /de phyir khyod kyi rtag tu ni/ /'khor bar sbyor bral mi bya'o/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la dngos grub mchog med do/

/de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i yid kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag /bde stong mkha' mnyam thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku mngon du byas/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ （《dzaṃ》+ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ / srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyor ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ ） lhan cig skyes las gang skyes pa/ / lhan cig skyes par de brjod bya/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig / dpe'i lhan skyes las don gyi ye shes mchon par bya ste/ kun khyab gdung med rgyun mi 'chad/ /rnam rtog thim zhing rang rig pa/ /zab mo gsal ba gnyis su med/ /thig le'i bde ba kha sbyor ba'o/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag/zung 'jug rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa ngo bo nyid sku ye shes rdo rje thob par 'gyur/ de nas bod lugs dang mthun par/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ / sogs dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag ni gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag deng gyur/ /deng nas brtsams te sogs/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ tshogs kyi mchod pa ni bdag 'jug gi sngon rol du bya ba yin la/ skabs 'dir byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /rjes kyi cho ga ni spyi'i rigs 'gre ste/ mchod pa gsar du gshom pa'am kha gsos sngon bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ ar+ghaṃ? nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra hūṃ sogs/ oṃ a mṛ ta/ a mṛ te/ swa da na hūṃ/ nang mchod phul/ mtshan nges pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyis/

bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ grub pa chen po brgyad dang zhi ba dang*/ rgyas pa dang*/ dbang du bya ba la sogs pa las thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrubs pas/ sems can gyi don rgya cher 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad thams cad rtsa ba nas zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten du bde legs rgya chen po rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum sogs bzla / gtso bo'i nus pa sogs dang*/ sngags dman pa dang sogs/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad sogs/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ oṃ dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ bi shwa ru pa dha ri gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā baṃ kṛ tan+te na sarba bud+dha sh+tsa bi sartsa na/ ma ma kar+yaṃ ku ru swāhā/ smon lam dang*/ bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod do/ /nyi ma tha ma la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba rnams spyi dang 'dra ba dang*/ khyad par du yang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'phreng ba'i lugs bzhin du byed do// //zhes pa sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'jug ngag 'don 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /slob ma dbang bskur gyi rim pa gzhan du bshad zin to/ /dge'o/ / zhus dag / mad+ga laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i bdag 'jug gzhan la phan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 310 -- PAGE 343 -- PAGE 309 -
